blocks.text: These endings are easily remembered when associated with the adverbs утром, вечером and днём, which are nothing but the instrumental case of the nouns утро, вечер and день.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: I drank a very hot double espresso at the coffee shop this morning.
exercises.ru: Сегодня ___ я выпил очень горячий двойной эспрессо в кофешопе.
exercises.why: The instrumental of the noun is the adverb of time. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
